Game Overview

In Rebel Run, the core idea is straightforward: speed through rebellious mayhem in Rebel Run. Dodge obstacles and collect coins while navigating underground routes to escape pursuers. Swift reflexes are crucial as you race against time in each tension-filled level, where every move tests your precision and agility. Embrace the thrill of freedom and chase victory!
